neural.objective: Training-standardized execution-return MSE + .1 * training-standardized 5-bar OHLCV auxiliary MSE
neural.input: Raw 125 observed bars, fixed 25x5 patches; per-window log OHLC/log1p volume normalization, no pretrained tokenizer

probe.objective: Mean unweighted binary log loss plus lambda/2 times sum of squared slopes in standardized coordinates. Intercept is not penalized. No auxiliary or return loss. Initialize slopes0 and intercept logit(training_up_frequency). Same single regularization value and full-batch float64 Newton solver for both families. No lambda, window, feature, seed or threshold search.

features: Frozen eval requires_grad=False; 25 flattened decoded coordinates; training 1/99 percent clipping and population standardization with sd floor1e-6. Four R18 market descriptors clipped/scaled separately on same training rows. Supervised R18 coefficient ray[:25] shared by both products. Volatility interaction residualized over R18+intercept; order interaction residualized over R19+intercept. Training least squares rcond1e-12, residual sd floor1e-6. Order uses exact trailing60close signs, mean adjacent product minus permutation expectation; neutral exact zero. R23 jointly refits all coefficients; R25 freezes R19 including intercept and fits only gamma. No full-pipeline OOF claim.
